name: Geolocation - Tian Maps
description: Adds the Chinese Tianditu (Tian) Maps provider to the Geolocation module.
project_description:
This is a submodule of geolocation which provide integration with tianditu 

Development initial is copied from geolocation_baidu 

 Functionality already implemented: 
 
 Position display 
 Position marker 
 Zoom control 
 
 Basic use steps: 
 
 Config Tianditu Api Key on /admin/config/services/geolocation/tian_maps 
 Add geolocation field on content entity type (Like node type). 
 Create a view which use display: Geolocation CommonMap 
 Choose the Geolocation source field on above display settings 
 Choose Map provider: 'Tian Maps' on above display settings 
 
 Detailed reference: how-to-create-a-view-of-locations-on-a-commonmap
